Name: Content Patcher -- Shaneley Pines
Author: NutGurgler
Description:
This mod replaces Shanes textures with those of a young Stanley Pines from Gravity Falls!
You wanna date that prickly grouch, right? We have the solution: replace one with another (but keep the best parts of both)!
Enjoy and tell me what you think!

Requires SMAPI and Content Patcher to work!

*Currently not included are unique seasonal portraits, as well as no beach sprites. They will be added in the coming weeks.

Downloads.Description: Stanley Pines Shane Replacement mod. These are the files you want!
